label: Killer Wrath
description: Inkanyamba's wrath track. 'Increase'/'Decrease' moves the tracking marker on the Killer Wrath card (range 1–10). 'Unleash' applies the effects listed at the current level (e.g. Horror up, Inkanyamba heals or takes a Killer Action). Reduce it with Atonement Action cards.

label: Divine Wrath
description: The angry gods' track. 'Increase'/'Decrease' moves the marker on the Divine Wrath card (1–10); 'Unleash' applies the effects at the current level. In the Finale, after the Killer Action you Unleash then Increase by 1. Reduced by Atonement cards and some items.

label: Sacred space
description: Marks the Burial Ground, Sacred Shrine and Holy Groves. The more Victims on Sacred spaces, the more likely Divine Wrath is to increase.

label: Killer start space
description: The Killer's starting space on a Setup card/board. In Terror From Above the 3-bird token starts here; The Organism places the Lab token here when not at Arctic Station; The Tormentor treats a random Setup card's version as the Killer's space before he appears.

label: Spawn Birds (replaces Killer moves)
description: In Terror From Above there is no Killer, so the Killer-moves icon means spawn Birds: roll 2 dice and use the Bird Spawn card for how many and where.

label: Bird attack (replaces Killer attacks)
description: In Terror From Above the Killer-attacks icon triggers an attack in the Final Girl's space (if at least one Bird) and every space with 3 Birds. Damage = number of Birds; Victims are prioritised.

label: Window space
description: A new space type on Creech Manor (two on the right of the house, one on the left). No rules of its own, but many Terror and Event cards reference Window spaces.

label: House space
description: Maple Lane's 12 Houses (3 per NW/SW/NE/SE Quadrant). Each counts as a Search space and draws from that Quadrant's Item deck. You can't walk into an occupied House – you need a Convince Action card.

label: Searched House (X token)
description: Placed on a House once it has been successfully searched; that House can no longer be searched.

label: Track mode
description: The Big Bad Wolf starts in TRACK mode. While in this mode, resolve only the Track effects on his Terror cards (not Slay).

label: Slay mode
description: When the Dark Power is revealed the Wolf switches to SLAY mode; resolve only the Slay effects. If he switches mid-Killer phase, Slay effects start next Killer phase. 'Killing Machine' applies both modes.

label: Vanish
description: The Evomorph immediately vanishes, ending the Killer phase: remove it from the board and place it on top of the Terror deck. While vanished you draw Ambush cards instead of resolving Killer phases.

label: Scan token
description: Placed by Scan Action cards to show you've scanned a space and the Evomorph isn't hiding there. Protects against Ambushes; one per space; if none left, move the farthest one.

label: EVOLVE keyword
description: Appears on the Evomorph's Bloodlust track. When Bloodlust reaches it, move the Evolution marker to the next stage (Hatchling → Youngling → Adult) and apply that stage's rules.

label: Active Killer – move up
description: Move the Active Killer token UP to the next Killer on the board (wraps round from top to bottom). That Killer resolves the rest of the action.

label: Active Killer – move down
description: Move the Active Killer token DOWN to the next Killer (wraps round). Dead Killers are skipped.

label: Active Killer token
description: Shows which of the three Intruders is currently active. Moves when you attack a Killer, when the up/down icons are resolved, or when the active one dies.

label: +1 die (Final Health bonus)
description: The bonus gained when a Killer's Final Health is revealed. With multiple Killers (Intruders, Mutated Organisms) you only get it once, however many Killers are on their Final Health.

label: Finale (F) icon
description: Marks effects that apply once the Finale has been triggered. For The Organism, Mutated Organisms perform the extra Killer Action effects shown next to this icon after the Finale.

ruleset_name: Patsy & the Zombies (Terror From the Grave vignette)
label: Spawn Zombies
description: Spawn the number of Zombies shown at the current Bloodlust level, one per Exit space starting with the space with fewest Zombies. Source icon is tiny, so this image is low resolution.

ruleset_name: Patsy & the Zombies (Terror From the Grave vignette)
label: Vehicle / own driver
description: On the board: a face-down Vehicle token, revealed when you first enter its Exit space. On a Vehicle Action card title: the vehicle has its own pilot/driver, so you needn't be in its space to use it.

label: Vehicle: Motorboat (Camp Happy Trails)
description: Lets you travel by water to any space bordering the lake or the lake centre. Victims may follow. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Golf Cart (Carnival of Blood)
description: Victims may not drive it but may follow; you can drive it to every space ignoring normal restrictions. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Helicopter (Creech Manor)
description: Has a pilot – you needn't be with it to use its Vehicle Action card. Outdoor spaces only. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Police Car (Maple Lane)
description: Has a driver; Street spaces only. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Super Loader (USS Konrad)
description: May not move through Maintenance Shafts. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Skidozer (Arctic Station 2891)
description: Outdoor spaces only. Next to the Lab with no Zombies in your space you can place the 'Hole' token for 2 Time. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Scooter (Wingard Cottage)
description: Outdoor spaces only; Victims may follow. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Raft (Storybook Woods)
description: Place the 4 Raft tokens touching the river and a non-exit space; moves only along the river token to token. Victims won't follow. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Gurney (Wolfe Asylum)
description: May move with you anywhere on the board. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Helicopter moves
description: The Helicopter moves 1 space along the Helicopter card track (between Station 2891 and Arctic Airport). Mainly from the 'Fly Faster' Action card.

label: Frostbite
description: You, each Victim and each Enemy in an outdoor space gain a Frostbite token, or lose 1 health if they already have one. Frostbite tokens are discarded in Upkeep for anyone indoors.

label: Raft token
description: A Raft item: choose 4 spaces where the raft can go ashore (touching the river and a non-exit space) and travel between them along the river.

label: Keycard token
description: Spend Time to pick up when you start/end in its space (gives you a Keycard Item). Spend by placing on a Maintenance Shaft to open it, or on a Maintenance card to activate a ship function. Free to use; can't be retrieved.

label: Maintenance space
description: Purple spaces (Trash Compactor, Furnace, Hangar, Bridge). Be here to place Keycards on the matching Maintenance card: Crusher, Incinerator, Airlock, Self Destruct.

label: Self Destruct countdown
description: Placed on the Self Destruct Maintenance card once activated; counts down to the ship exploding. Get to an Escape Pod in time – if the Killer dies with you, you still lose.

label: Super Loader token
description: Starts in the Hangar. Usable only with the Super Loader Key Item. Unequip it or lose the key and the token stays in your current space.

label: Supply: Discarded Tools
description: Supply Item symbol on the board. While in that space, spend 1 Time to take the Discarded Tools Supply card for crafting.

label: Supply: Nails
description: Supply Item symbol. Spend 1 Time in this space to take the Nails Supply card.

label: Supply: Rope
description: Supply Item symbol. Spend 1 Time in this space to take the Rope Supply card.

label: Supply: Wood
description: Supply Item symbol. Spend 1 Time in this space to take the Wood Supply card.

label: Stun token
description: Placed under a Stunned Enemy: next Killer phase it ignores all Killer-moves icons (but still attacks). Discarded in Upkeep.

label: Pill token / White pill
description: End movement in its space and spend 1 Time to pick it up and place it under your Pill Effects card. Consume during the Action phase for effects, then draw Side Effects.

label: Pill: Yellow
description: One of 3 yellow pills. See the Pill Effects card; taking one of each colour lets you draw an Amped card.

label: Pill: Wild
description: The single wild pill – counts as any colour.

label: Destiny symbol
description: Resolve the effect shown on the Death Order card. Killer Actions on Terror cards count as Destiny symbols. Ignore one with Thwart Destiny.

label: Death token
description: Back of the 5 Death tokens on the Death Order card; they set the order Fated Victims must be saved in and are flipped by Fated Death Terror cards.

label: Final Girl Noise
description: The Eyeless targets you if your Noise level ≥ this number AND he can reach you with his movement; otherwise use the card's 'Otherwise' effect.

label: Countdown token
description: Two sit under the Cybernetic Parts on the back of the Finale. Once all parts are gone, remove one each Killer phase and increase Bloodlust; the second brings in Mark X.

label: Cybernetic Part
description: Each destroyed part (2 damage in one phase) is rolled out on the board near Mark V. Spend Time to pick up; spend more to re-install them and repair Mark V as an Ally.

label: Pull into the Mirror Dimension
description: Slayer targets the closest Victim in Our Dimension and pulls them into the Mirror Dimension (swap to a grey meeple, panic them). If none, increase Bloodlust instead.

label: Victim Death Trap
description: Draw a Victim Death Trap card and trap the target Victim; they can't move and must escape via the card's Escape Tasks.

label: Final Girl Death Trap
description: Draw a Final Girl Death Trap card: you're Trapped. Reach the end of the trap and you die.

label: Progress Death Traps
description: Advance the meeples on all active Death Traps one space and apply that space's effect.

label: Bottom this Terror card
description: Place this Terror card face down at the bottom of the Terror deck.

label: Roll the d20
description: Roll the 20-sided die.

label: Hellscape tile: star
description: One of the 4 double-sided Hellscape tile symbols, used by Hellscape dice and Shift/Swap/Flip/Rearrange effects. Small source, so low resolution.

label: Hellscape tile: circle
description: Hellscape tile symbol (see star).

label: Hellscape tile: bars
description: Hellscape tile symbol (see star).

label: Hellscape tile: cog
description: Hellscape tile symbol (see star).

label: Hellscape dice
description: Rolled each Upkeep: matching symbols Flip that tile; different symbols Swap the indicated tiles.

label: Locked token
description: Placed on an Exit space; no Victims can be saved there until Unlocked. Used by Marrek Warehouse and the Tormentor's 'No Escape!' Finale.

label: Rack space
description: Tops of the warehouse storage racks. Enemies and Victims move between them normally; you need Climb to get up and Leap to jump between them.

label: Sinkhole
description: When a space Collapses, Victims there are killed; you and any Enemies there take damage and panic out. A Sinkhole token is placed: no one can enter or pass through that space for the rest of the game.

label: Boulder space
description: Safe from Sand Snake attacks; some cards reference them.

label: Savior start space
description: Where the Savior (orange Special Victim meeple) starts, per the Setup card.

label: Railing space
description: Overlooks the Food Court. You or an Ally can jump down (roll: 5–6 safe, 1–4 take damage). Anyone damaged here falls to the Food Court below and takes extra damage.

label: Spawn Birds (claw)
description: The bird-claw icon on Terror From Above cards. Like the boot, it means spawn Birds: roll 2 dice and use the Bird Spawn card.

label: Sacred Groves token: warning
description: One of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. The rule sheet only lists them as 'various tokens' – the card that places it explains what it does.

label: Sacred Groves token: sign (x2)
description: Two of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. Effect explained on the card that places it.

label: Sacred Groves token: fire
description: One of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. Effect explained on the card that places it.

label: Sacred Groves token: burst
description: One of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. Effect explained on the card that places it.

label: Pill: Blue
description: One of 3 blue pills (see Pill Effects card). Partly hidden on the sheet, so recoloured from the yellow pill – same shape, true blue.

label: Pill: Pink
description: One of 3 pink pills (see Pill Effects card). Partly hidden on the sheet, so recoloured from the yellow pill.

label: Arrow token
description: Sits above the Consequence cards and moves right each time a Death token is resolved, always matching the next Death token on the Death Order card. A killed Fated Victim goes on the Consequence card under the Arrow.

label: Noise marker
description: Tracks your Noise level on the Time track. +1 per Action card resolved in the Action phase, plus Item noise. Resets to 0 at the end of Upkeep.

label: Noise card (+1 / +3)
description: Tucked under an Item as a reminder: +1 Noise = heard in the same space (melee etc.), +3 = heard at a distance (guns, whistles, vehicles). Silent items get no card. Tiny source, low resolution.

label: Death Trap skull space
description: A space on a Death Trap card. When a Trapped meeple advances onto it, apply that effect (e.g. increase Horror).

label: Death Trap final space
description: The last space of a Death Trap. A Victim reaching it dies (Bloodlust up, apply Fail Result); the Final Girl reaching it dies and loses immediately.
